more_info.daily_intake:
0–0.7 mg sulphur dioxide equivalents/kg body weight/day, combined JECFA sulphite group (JECFA, 1998).
EFSA withdrew its temporary group ADI in 2022.
more_info.side_effects:
Food-use exposure may concern high consumers (EFSA, 2022).
Toxicology gaps prevented a new intake limit.
more_info.overview: Calcium sulphite is an inorganic calcium sulphite preparation within the sulphite preservative family. Its preservative role is to limit spoilage caused by microorganisms and extend the storage life of the food. The specified material is supplied as white powder or crystalline material.
more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain other confectionery including breath freshening microsweets; decorations, coatings and fillings, except fruit-based fillings covered by category 4.2.4; fruit juices as defined by Directive 2001/112/EC and vegetable juices; sweet baked goods; potato-, cereal-, flour- or starch-based snacks; processed nuts.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
